thread.title: Dow Futures Rip Higher As China Trade War Fears Subside

author: EdJenner
title: Dow Futures Rip Higher As China Trade War Fears Subside
text:
Page Four Dow Futures Rip Higher As China Trade War Fears Subside
Dow Jones futures moved higher by 220 points early Monday for nearly a 1% gain, after Treasury Secretary Steve Mnuchin on Sunday said a China trade war is “on hold,” strengthening the U.S. dollar on the news. Since hitting a low of 88.16 in mid-February, the U.S. dollar index is up about 6.1%.
X
S&P 500 futures added 0.6% and the Nasdaq 100 picked up 0.7%. FAANG stocks performed in line with the indexes in early trading. Facebook ( FB ), Amazon.com ( AZMN ), Netflix ( NFLX ) and Google parent Alphabet ( GOOGL ) showed gains of 0.8% to 1.2%.
Apple ( AAPL ) added 0.9% to around 188. Resistance has appeared near 190, but the stock continues to hold gains after a breakout from a double-bottom base. The buy point was 179.04, 10 cents above its April 17 intraday high of 178.94.
For the bulls, the strength was good to see after the Nasdaq composite marked a mild distribution day Friday. Signs of institutional selling have been more prominent in the S&P 500 in recent weeks, but the market remains in a confirmed uptrend until proven otherwise.
The Russell 2000 small-cap index notched its third-straight record closing high Friday. The Ishares Russell 2000 ( IWM ) fund added 0.4% before Monday’s opening bell. GE, Boeing, Caterpillar Lead Dow Jones Futures
Early leaders in the Dow included General Electric ( GE ). Shares were up nearly 3% on news the industrial conglomerate selling its transportation business to Wabtec ( WAB ). The reported price tag is $11.1 billion.
